name: product-toolkit
description: Claude Code skills library — 8 original, interlocking slash commands covering the full product lifecycle: scaffold → audit → quality-gate → ship.
author: kish21

commands.purpose: Scaffold a complete production-ready project foundation (runtime-tested: backend boots, frontends build, CI passes day one)

highlights: MCP servers so Claude can query your dev DB and API

commands.purpose: Audit any AI project for production readiness across 8 categories
11-category end-of-phase quality gate before pushing to remote
Grade existing docs against the bar an external reader would actually apply
Scaffold ONE new doc grounded in actual code state
Build production-grade frontend interfaces avoiding generic AI aesthetics
Create a React component following design system rules
Standard GitHub branch → PR → CI → merge workflow

notes: v1.1.0: removed 5 Anthropic-published skills (get originals from Anthropic); fixed cross-skill contradictions; new-project gained SQLAlchemy models + Alembic and was runtime-tested end to end.
Each command file has YAML frontmatter (name, description) so it self-identifies on disk.
Distribution model: fork + one-liner install, or package as a Claude Code plugin.
